## bodh-p04-v31 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Opening holds means: powerful thought-decay-opening state, manifold. Nothing thought, thoughts decay; play-power enamoured in being's field. Attached sees; tightening brahma-teachers call it — fie. Rest-points and passion-grasps listed whole. Goddess-voiced opening; strong obtain supreme reward in days. Samādhi-impressed roams pure-rayed, reflecting by emission-power doubled. Even distracted, own form shines for awareness-fixed bliss-essenced yogi. Bliss-manifest mantra-strong full-I-knowing: inward devotee's. Sporting stayed mantra-situated; strong playing power-expanded. Freedom his, everywhere, world-Lord's, difference-tasting, wonder-state-unbroken.

*Rasa: vīra of means; śānta-vīra of decayed thoughts; vīra of recorded calling; adbhuta of listed rests; vīra of goddess-voiced reward; vīra of doubled reflecting; vīra of distraction-proof shining; vīra of mantra-strength; līlā-vīra of situated sport; vīra of unbroken freedom — The sthāyibhāva is exultation: opened middle, powerful stand. Means relished. The sthāyibhāva is peaceful exultation: nothing thought, thoughts decayed. Decay relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: seen bright, called tight. Quoting relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: rests listed whole. Listing relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: spoken goddess, won reward. Voicing relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: roaming, reflecting, doubled. Roaming relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: distracted even, shining full. Shining relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: manifest, strengthened, devotee's. Strength relished. The sthāyibhāva is playful exultation: stayed, strong, sporting. Situating relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: free, tasting, unbroken. Unbrokenness relished.*
